painted.label: Painted adventure
painted.prompt: Restrained hand-painted 1990s fantasy RPG equipment illustration, opaque gouache-like colour modelling, broad painted planes, believable cloth folds and metal planes, sparse dry-brush marks, selective dark accents along occluding contours. Slightly irregular handmade edges, original local colours; descriptive rather than ornamental. Smoothly drawn high resolution shapes, no square pixel clusters.

inked.label: Inked dark fantasy / UI kin
inked.prompt: Inked dark-fantasy illustration with a tight palette: economical dark-brown contour and broken interior ink accents, flat-to-painted natural local colour, rough-edged gouache highlights and controlled hatching in the deepest shadow. The tone should sit beside weathered-stone and brass game UI without turning the object into stone or adding fittings. Strong silhouette, readable middle tones, antique craft rather than polished digital fantasy.

gouache.label: Warm storybook gouache
gouache.prompt: Old illustrated fantasy bestiary and adventure-book gouache, gentle warm/cool colour interplay within the object's original colours, opaque layered brush shapes, softly worn paint and delicate dry-brush edges. A tactile quietly charming handmade object with simple modelling and a few fine descriptive accents. No black comic outline, no paper background, no ornamental manuscript border and no invented decoration.

etched.label: Tinted engraving
etched.prompt: A restrained antique fantasy equipment engraving with fine broken umber contour, short directional crosshatching that wraps the existing volumes, and opaque muted natural-colour washes. Preserve the object's tan or gold local colour rather than turning the image sepia or monochrome. Readable large shapes before line texture; use very little hatching in lit areas, no surrounding page, border or typography.

collection_rules: Make this belong to one coherent set of grounded, slightly timeworn fantasy RPG equipment art. Keep the source's silhouette, the parts of the body it covers, its pose and its local colours: do not tint every material brown. Draw only the garment or armour piece itself, as worn on an invisible, headless body: no skin, no body, head, hands or feet unless the source clearly shows them. No weapon, text, border, scenery, shadow or second figure.
presentation: One isolated garment on a perfectly flat solid dark slate grey background, RGB 48,52,59. No floor, no background texture and no cast shadow outside the garment. The whole garment visible with breathing room, centred. Longest extent roughly three quarters of a square canvas. Preserve the source view and rotation. Broad soft light from the upper left, restrained highlights and readable shadow planes. Draw actual new fine forms with clean deliberate edges rather than smoothing or retaining square source pixels.
title: Female human armor / Qwen then retro
task: Task: Redraw a very small classic fantasy RPG worn-equipment paper-doll layer as newly illustrated high resolution art. Reconstruct plausible missing detail; do not enlarge or trace the pixel blocks.
